description: This file defines a Kubernetes client informer for CertificateSigningRequest resources, including functions to create and manage shared informers with various options.

classes.name: certificateSigningRequestInformer
classes.description: Implementation of the CertificateSigningRequestInformer interface, managing shared informer factory and list options.

methods.description: Creates a new shared informer with custom options, including resync period and indexers.
